title: Poly-FEVER: A Multilingual Fact Verification Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM hallucination detection and fact verification accuracy across 11 different languages using the Poly-FEVER benchmark, and correlating model performance with language resource availability (measured via automated web search result counts).

Using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) to categorize factual claims into 22 specific topics and analyzing how hallucination detection accuracy fluctuates across these different subject areas within and across various languages.
